import java.util.Scanner;

public class LuckyTickets {

    private static final int MOD = 998244353;

    private static long fastPow(long base, long exponent) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        
        int[] allowedDigits = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            allowedDigits[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        
        int halfN = n / 2;
        
        // dp[i][j] = number of ways to get sum j using i digits
        long[][] dp = new long[halfN + 1][5000]; // max sum is 9 * halfN, but let's be safe
        
        // Base case: 0 digits, sum 0
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        
        for (int pos = 1; pos <= halfN; pos++) {
            for (int sum = 0; sum < 5000; sum++) {
                for (int digit : allowedDigits) {
                    if (sum - digit >= 0) {
                        dp[pos][sum] = (dp[pos][sum] + dp[pos - 1][sum - digit]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Count lucky tickets: sum of (dp[halfN][s] * dp[halfN][s]) for all s
        long answer = 0;
        for (int sum = 0; sum < 5000; sum++) {
            answer = (answer + dp[halfN][sum] * dp[halfN][sum]) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
